title: Slimline Launch Synchronization Checklist for New Model Adds
creator: Maya Patel
description: A compact, execution-focused checklist to coordinate a low-friction launch of a new model variant into the Redwood model catalog. This ticket captures cross-team touchpoints required to publish the model, validate perf/cost tradeoffs, update docs and release notes, and synchronize comms with Marketing and Support for a minimal-governance rollout.
checklist: Product: finalize public short description + supported endpoints (text generation, chat, embeddings) — owner: Rafael Diaz — deliverable: 2-paragraph blurb and capability matrix — due: 2026-03-17

Engineering: perf smoke test against canonical workloads (latency P50/P95, throughput with 8 concurrent connections) — owner: Priya Singh (ENG-1987) — deliverable: perf dashboard link and short summary — due: 2026-03-18

Research: run quality eval suite (20 prompt families, sampling and greedy baselines) and surface regression risers — owner: Ben O'Connor — deliverable: eval report and top-5 failure cases — due: 2026-03-18

Runtime: confirm supported quantization profile and recommended instance types (GPU/CPU fallback guidance) — owner: Linh Tran — deliverable: runtime-compat matrix and recommended config snippet — due: 2026-03-19
Console: add model tile in catalog UI + model tags and filters (beta flag toggle) — owner: Jordan Lee — deliverable: staging screenshot and migration notes — due: 2026-03-20
Docs: create concise Quickstart (3 steps) + API example snippets for SDK and curl — owner: Sofia Ramirez — deliverable: docs PR link and rendered preview — due: 2026-03-21

Benchmarks: publish cost/latency benchmark card for common sequence lengths and price-per-1000 tokens estimate — owner: Miguel Alvarez — deliverable: benchmark cards + short methodology blurb — due: 2026-03-21
Release notes: draft plain-language release notes and technical changelog entry with migration notes — owner: Rafael Diaz — deliverable: RN draft and internal TL;DR — due: 2026-03-22

Marketing: prepare one announcement post (email + LinkedIn short copy) and promotional artifact (1-page model cheat sheet) — owner: Priya Mehta — deliverable: assets and scheduled publish date — due: 2026-03-23
Support: prepare triage FAQ, known limitations, and runbook for common customer issues — owner: Aaron Kim — deliverable: support doc and training sync minutes — due: 2026-03-23
Legal/Compliance: confirm any licensing or model card disclaimers required for public listing — owner: Nina Volkov — deliverable: sign-off or list of required edits — due: 2026-03-20

Rollout: define rollout mode (immediate public vs. gated beta) and canary policy (percent traffic, fallback model) — owner: Rafael Diaz — deliverable: rollout config and rollback criteria — due: 2026-03-24
Billing: verify pricing mapping and internal metering labels for analytics + billing pipeline QA — owner: Samir Patel — deliverable: billing config and test invoice — due: 2026-03-24
Post-launch: schedule 1-week observation window with daily SLO checks and a retrospective slot — owner: PM team — deliverable: observation runbook and retrospective agenda — due: 2026-03-31
acceptance_criteria: All owners have submitted their deliverables to the linked PRs/dashboards
Perf benchmarks meet the established minimums (P50 latency and cost targets) or documented deviations exist with mitigation plan
Docs and Quickstart are published on docs.redwood.ai and render without errors
Release notes approved by Product and Marketing and scheduled in the release calendar
Support runbook uploaded and first-line Support has completed the 30-min briefing
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Performance regression at high concurrency — Mitigation: limit initial GA to 50% of typical throughput and enable KV caching policy by default
Risk: Unexpected hallucination patterns in a prompt family — Mitigation: mark affected patterns in docs, add prompt guidance, and schedule follow-up model tuning evaluation
Risk: Billing label mismatch causes analytics gaps — Mitigation: pre-launch billing smoke tests and one test invoice review
Risk: Legal needs additional disclaimer — Mitigation: hold public listing until compliance sign-off; prepare minimally disruptive language variants
